name: 2D Gaussian Probability Density (Standard)
definition: Computes the probability density function (PDF) value of a 2D Gaussian at point xy, given mean and covariance matrix.
summary: It computes the normalized probability density of a 2D Gaussian using an explicit covariance matrix, distinguishing itself from the conic variant by avoiding pre-computed inverse matrices and from the unnormalized variant by including the normalization constant.
